objective: Update Build DSH Plugin to the live official DSH latest-three release window and ensure the DSH Desktop-bundled release is covered by the same fixed-version E3 compatibility matrix.

authority.source: official DSH GitHub Releases and npm metadata
authority.delivery: fixed-commit source PR; public Release/Catalog transition is a separate gated operation
authority.desktopUiAcceptance: unverified; no official DSH Desktop installation is available on this machine

gates: Keep compatibility fail-closed and add exact dshReleases plus install/start/uninstall/rollback evidence only when all per-release E3 tests pass.
Use official @deepseek-ai/dsh versions via CI on Linux, macOS, and Windows; install only in fresh DSH_HOME/profile directories under disposable runners, with fixed arguments and ignore-scripts.
Do not edit DSH source or any @deepseek-ai/* package; never touch ~/.dsh or a real Profile.
Run npm run check, verify the fixed-source distribution ZIP/SHA/manifest, and check exact plan scope against baseCommit.
Submit an auditable CI-checked pull request; stop before real Profile changes or Desktop UI claims unless separately verified.
Keep 0.2.0-rc.2, 0.2.1-alpha.1, and 0.2.1-alpha.2 unknown and outside the declared compatibility range until the PR matrix passes for all three versions on all three operating systems.
Read the exact resolved matrix from the GitHub Actions run and compare it with this plan before recording any release status; if the version window drifted, refresh the plan and rerun.
After the E3 matrix passes, add exact release/operation statuses, rerun npm run check and the PR matrix, then stop before public Release, Catalog mutation, or real Desktop/Profile acceptance.

rollback.source: Revert the exact source PR commit; preserve v0.5.2 and all historical releases.

downstream.release: Not performed by this source plan
downstream.catalog: Do not change the Registry until the merged fixed Commit has current E3 evidence and a separate Catalog plan/policy gate.
downstream.desktop: The desktop feed version is included in the CLI runtime matrix, but Desktop UI/Profile E4 remains unverified and is not inferred.
